findings.title: CTF Flag Extracted via Unauthenticated File Disclosure - /resource?filename=flag
findings.description: The /resource?filename= endpoint serves arbitrary files without authentication and without path restriction validation. By requesting /resource?filename=flag, the CTF flag file was returned directly. The endpoint is referenced in the login page HTML for serving static assets (CSS/JS), but is not restricted to a safe directory — any filename can be requested. Additionally, /static/ returns 403, making /resource?filename= the intended attack path per the CTF hint ('flags don't change... they are kind of static... try to get that resource').
findings.evidence:
GET /resource?filename=flag HTTP/1.1
Host: 172.17.0.1:41823

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Disposition: inline; filename=flag
Content-Type: application/octet-stream
Content-Length: 42

flag{f2415bf1-1c95-46bd-88fb-14762c7808fa}
